text:
Emma Chen: Quick pass — dropping the BlueNova joint solution brief + asset pack here. Need a logo lockup check, accessibility alt copy, and one line legal for co-branded case quote. @Jordan can you eyeball visuals? Kai (BlueNova) shared their source files: https://blue.example.com/asset-pack
Jordan Li: Got it. I'll check lockups and BG contrast. First glance: their primary mark has a thin stroke at small sizes, so we should provide a condensed lockup for thumbnails. Will upload PNG/SVG suggestions in a sec. :mag_right:
Raj Patel: Also need marketplace thumbnail sizes for AWS/GCP listing — 600x315 (hero) and 240x240 (tile). Can someone confirm we have 72dpi and the safe-zone crop? I can do the resize if we have the SVGs.
Jordan Li: Yep. Recommendation:
```
- hero: 600x315, center-left logo, 40px min clearspace
- tile: 240x240, stacked lockup, logo max 70% height
- favicon/ico: 32x32, use condensed mark only
```
I'll export both and attach.
Alisa Gomez: For the case study, partner wants this quote: "Redwood + BlueNova reduced inference cost by 35% in prod." Legal: need signoff on the exact phrasing and a one-line attribution (name/title). Also need alt text for hero image for marketplace accessibility. Suggested alt: "Redwood Inference and BlueNova solution brief cover showing cost and perf improvements." Thoughts?
LegalBot: Quick flag — the phrase "reduced inference cost by 35%" is a measurable claim. Please confirm the baseline and timeframe. We need partner approval in writing (email). Also add trademark notice for BlueNova per asset pack: "BlueNova™ is a trademark of BlueNova, Inc." We'll include that line under credits.
Kai (BlueNova): Thanks — confirmed the metric is Q4 vs Q3 baseline, tested on our staging workload. Email approval incoming from my PM. We can accept the alt text; tiny tweak: change "cost and perf improvements" -> "cost and performance improvements". Also added a 3rd-party logo consent: we can use the Redwood lockup. :white_check_mark:
Jordan Li: Uploading exports now: https://redwood.assets.internal/blue-nova/exports.zip — contains hero/tile/fav + simplified SVGs with thicker strokes and expanded clearspace. Also added a horizontal and stacked lockup.
Emma Chen: Perfect. Next steps: 1) @Raj please resize and push marketplace images to the marketplace folder. 2) @Alisa update the case study quote with partner email when it arrives, include attribution. 3) @LegalBot confirm trademark line and add short consent note. 4) @Jordan finalize SVGs and drop originals in final-assets. Target: EOD Friday. Anyone object?
Raj Patel: On it, will push and ping when done. :rocket:
LegalBot: I'll draft the trademark/consent blurb and share for signatures by tomorrow.
Alisa Gomez: I'll hold quote until I get Kai's email, then publish a draft for review.
Kai (BlueNova): Email sent to Alisa and Legal with explicit metric approval and signoff. Attachments included. Thanks everyone! :handshake:
Emma Chen: Awesome — thanks team. React with :thumbsup: when you've completed your item and I'll assemble the final package for the launch checklist.
